parts.lead:
The pseudocode shown represents a queue Abstract Data Type (ADT) with procedures for initialisation and to add new items. It is incomplete.

```text
CONSTANT MaxLength = 50
DECLARE FrontPointer : INTEGER
DECLARE RearPointer : INTEGER
DECLARE Length : INTEGER
DECLARE Queue : ARRAY[0 : MaxLength - 1] OF STRING

// initialisation of queue
PROCEDURE Initialise
    FrontPointer ← -1

    [[blank]]
    [[blank]] ← 0
ENDPROCEDURE

// adding a new item to the queue
PROCEDURE Enqueue(NewItem : STRING)

    IF [[blank]] THEN

        RearPointer ← [[blank]]
        IF RearPointer > MaxLength - 1 THEN
            RearPointer ← 0
        ENDIF

        [[blank]]
        Length ← Length + 1
    ENDIF
ENDPROCEDURE
```
